profile.headline: Software Engineer at Rockstar and Leader for IGDA San Diego Chapter
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer industry. Skilled in C#,  Asp.Net, Unity3D, and game design.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Programmed and developed warehousing systems using C#, ASP.NET.
-Worked with Vue.js javascript framework for web development frontend.
-Utilized Cloud hosting on Azure.
-Implemented Single Sign On using Auth0.
-Built websites and RESTful Web APIs with high I/O requirements and response times.

positions.title: Indie MMO Developer
positions.description:
I make games! I was previously making TwoKinds Online.
- Game development using Unity3d
- Game server networking using SpatialOS
- Web API and database access

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
-Programmed and designed internal desktop software, websites,  and Client eCommerce connections for Shopify and other online sales channels.
-Designed and built web applications in C# with ASP.NET.
-Managed and utilized SQL Server databases.
-Built solutions for clients business needs.
-Created responsive UI with HTML5, Javascript, JQuery and CSS3.
-Designed and developed RESTful Web APIs.

volunteerExperiences.role: Chair - Board of Organizers - San Diego Chapter
volunteerExperiences.description: I run events like talks, panels, showcases and game jams for the San Diego game developer community.
